name: The Western Watch

faq.answer: Peacekeeper Vaaniel commands the peacekeepers at the western watchtower. Cultists are attacking, and you are sent to find him and tell him to bring his garrison back to the village quickly.
Local leaders ordered the peacekeepers to leave because the cult assaults were costing too many lives. They want the defenders gathered at the village to protect its people.
faq.q: Why were the peacekeepers ordered to abandon the watchtower?

faq.answer: Storm-wielding cult spellcasters killed Peacekeeper Vaaniel. Lightning and elemental magic left burns and scorch marks on him and the tower's defenders.
A hostile cult attacked the western watchtower with destructive storm magic. Local commanders do not know why the cult wants the tower, but the attack threatens nearby settlements.
The western watchtower stands southwest of the local settlement, guarding the western approaches. Its isolation left it vulnerable to cult assaults.
faq.q: Where is the western watchtower located?

faq.answer: The watchtower had fallen by the time runners arrived with orders to evacuate. Cult spellcasters killed Peacekeeper Vaaniel and the other defenders shortly before aid could reach them.
faq.q: What happened to the garrison at the tower?

sections.body: The western watchtower guards the frontier southwest of the settlement. Cultists have renewed their assault, and local leaders decide the isolated post costs too many lives to defend. So they prepare orders recalling the peacekeepers. They hope to spare more lives and gather every defender to protect the village and its people.
sections.title: A Costly Outpost

sections.body: Peacekeeper Vaaniel commanded the garrison at the western watch. The withdrawal order arrived too late. Storm-wielding cult spellcasters had overrun the tower before messengers reached it. Vaaniel and his garrison lay dead among scorched stone and lightning burns.
sections.title: Too Late to Retreat

summary: At the outpost southwest of the settlement, cultists press the defenders, and local leaders call them back. They judge the tower too costly to hold and turn to protecting the village.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Western Watch
